claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: When sufficiently concentrated aqueous barium and sulfate ions are mixed, which sparingly soluble solid can precipitate? Barium and sulfate ions can form sparingly soluble solid BaSO₄. Whether precipitation occurs depends on the ion concentrations relative to the solubility equilibrium.
